question: The Rowlatt Act was passed in the year
solution:
The correct answer is __**1919.**__

__
 
• In **March 1919, the government passed the Rowlatt Act__** but every single Indian member of the Central Legislative Council opposed the Act.

 __
 
• While opposing the Act, **Mohammad Ali Jinnah, Madan Mohan Malaviya, and Mazhar-ul-Huq** resigned their membership from the Council.
 
• This act was passed on recommendations of the **Sedition Committee chaired by Sir Sidney Rowlatt.**
 
• According to this act, **detention of political prisoners without trial for two years **was allowed.
